entries.title: Isaiah 37:1
segments: ¶And so it was, when King Hezekiah heard [it], that he tore his clothes, covered himself with sackcloth, and went into the house of the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:2
segments: Then he sent Eliakim, who [was] over the household, Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:3
segments: And they said to him, "Thus says Hezekiah: 'This day [is] a day of trouble and rebuke and blasphemy; for the children have come to birth, but [there is] no strength to bring them forth.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:4
segments: 'It may be that the LORD your God will hear the words of [the] Rabshakeh, whom his master the king of Assyria has sent to reproach the living God, and will rebuke the words which the LORD your God has heard. Therefore lift up [your] prayer for the remnant that is left.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 37:5
segments: So the servants of King Hezekiah came to Isaiah.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:6
segments: And Isaiah said to them, "Thus shall you say to your master, 'Thus says the LORD: "Do not be afraid of the words which you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Assyria have blasphemed Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:7
segments: "Surely I will send a spirit upon him, and he shall hear a rumor and return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land."'"

entries.title: Isaiah 37:8
segments: ¶Then [the] Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Assyria warring against Libnah, for he heard that he had departed from Lachish.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:9
segments: And the king heard concerning Tirhakah king of Ethiopia, "He has come out to make war with you." So when he heard [it], he sent messengers to Hezekiah, saying,

entries.title: Isaiah 37:10
segments: "Thus you shall speak to Hezekiah king of Judah, saying: 'Do not let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, "Jerusalem shall not be given into the hand of the king of Assyria."

entries.title: Isaiah 37:11
segments: 'Look! You have heard what the kings of Assyria have done to all lands by utterly destroying them; and shall you be delivered?

entries.title: Isaiah 37:12
segments: 'Have the gods of the nations delivered those whom my fathers have destroyed, Gozan and Haran and Rezeph, and the people of Eden who [were] in Telassar?

entries.title: Isaiah 37:13
segments: 'Where [is] the king of Hamath, the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, Hena, and Ivah?'"

entries.title: Isaiah 37:14
segments: And Hezekiah received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Hezekiah went up to the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:15
segments: Then Hezekiah prayed to the LORD, saying:

entries.title: Isaiah 37:16
segments: "O LORD of hosts, God of Israel, [the One] who dwells [between] the cherubim, You [are] God, You alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth. You have made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:17
segments: "Incline Your ear, O LORD, and hear; open Your eyes, O LORD, and see; and hear all the words of Sennacherib, which he has sent to reproach the living God.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:18
segments: "Truly, LORD, the kings of Assyria have laid waste all the nations and their lands,

entries.title: Isaiah 37:19
segments: "and have cast their gods into the fire; for they [were] not gods, but the work of men's hands-wood and stone. Therefore they have destroyed them.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:20
segments: "Now therefore, O LORD our God, save us from his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that You [are] the LORD, You alone."

entries.title: Isaiah 37:21
segments: ¶Then Isaiah the son of Amoz sent to Hezekiah, saying, "Thus says the LORD God of Israel, 'Because you have prayed to Me against Sennacherib king of Assyria,

entries.title: Isaiah 37:22
segments: 'this [is] the word which the LORD has spoken concerning him: "The virgin, the daughter of Zion, Has despised you, laughed you to scorn; The daughter of Jerusalem Has shaken [her] head behind your back!

entries.title: Isaiah 37:23
segments: "Whom have you reproached and blasphemed? Against whom have you raised [your] voice, And lifted up your eyes on high? Against the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:24
segments: By your servants you have reproached the Lord, And said, 'By the multitude of my chariots I have come up to the height of the mountains, To the limits of Lebanon; I will cut down its tall cedars [And] its choice cypress trees; I will enter its farthest height, To its fruitful forest.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:25
segments: I have dug and drunk water, And with the soles of my feet I have dried up All the brooks of defense.'

entries.title: Isaiah 37:26
segments: "Did you not hear long ago [How] I made it, From ancient times that I formed it? Now I have brought it to pass, That you should be For crushing fortified cities [into] heaps of ruins.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:27
segments: Therefore their inhabitants [had] little power; They were dismayed and confounded; They were [as] the grass of the field And the green herb, [As] the grass on the housetops And [grain] blighted before it is grown.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:28
segments: "But I know your dwelling place, Your going out and your coming in, And your rage against Me.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:29
segments: Because your rage against Me and your tumult Have come up to My ears, Therefore I will put My hook in your nose And My bridle in your lips, And I will turn you back By the way which you came."'

entries.title: Isaiah 37:30
segments: "This [shall be] a sign to you: You shall eat this year such as grows of itself, And the second year what springs from the same; Also in the third year sow and reap, Plant vineyards and eat the fruit of them.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:31
segments: And the remnant who have escaped of the house of Judah Shall again take root downward, And bear fruit upward.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:32
segments: For out of Jerusalem shall go a remnant, And those who escape from Mount Zion. The zeal of the LORD of hosts will do this.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:33
segments: "Therefore thus says the LORD concerning the king of Assyria: 'He shall not come into this city, Nor shoot an arrow there, Nor come before it with shield, Nor build a siege mound against it.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:34
segments: By the way that he came, By the same shall he return; And he shall not come into this city,' Says the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:35
segments: 'For I will defend this city, to save it For My own sake and for My servant David's sake.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 37:36
segments: Then the angel of the LORD went out, and killed in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred and eighty-five thousand; and when [people] arose early in the morning, there were the corpses-all dead.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:37
segments: So Sennacherib king of Assyria departed and went away, returned [home], and remained at Nineveh.

entries.title: Isaiah 37:38
segments: Now it came to pass, as he was worshiping in the house of Nisroch his god, that his sons Adrammelech and Sharezer struck him down with the sword; and they escaped into the land of Ararat. Then Esarhaddon his son reigned in his place.
